response.sql: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT c.location AS city, COUNT(q.qualifyId) AS qualifying_count FROM circuits AS c LEFT JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY c.location), city_shares AS (SELECT city, qualifying_count, 1.0 * qualifying_count / SUM(qualifying_count) OVER () AS share FROM city_counts), with_average AS (SELECT city, qualifying_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM city_shares) SELECT city, qualifying_count, share, share - average_share AS share_above_average FROM with_average WHERE share > average_share;
